data.overview: Five years after a rift opened between worlds and released predators into ours, a former soldier has hidden his daughter on a remote island and trained her to survive. As the barrier begins to fail again, their refuge becomes the first place the creatures seek.
data.tagline: There is nowhere beyond the edge.
